speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I see you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To understand the cause, can you tell me exactly when your symptoms started and how high your fever has reached?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. The consumption of ice cream is an unusual detail; could you describe exactly how it was prepared and if it involved unpasteurized cream, raw eggs, or was stored improperly before you ate it? Additionally, have you noticed any rash on your body or experienced muscle aches alongside your fatigue?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC), Liver Function Tests (LFTS), and Parvovirus B19 Serology. REQUEST IMAGES: Blood_Smear, Abdominal_Ultrasound.
Could you please confirm if you have a history of blood disorders like sickle cell anemia or hemoglobinopathies, and have you noticed any bruising or jaundice?
